product.ta-walkstation-386dx.summary: The Walkstation 386DX was the range’s 33 MHz portable with a detachable keyboard.
product.ta-walkstation-386dx.history: The Centre for Computing History dates the Olivetti D33 to 1991 and records its sale as the Walkstation System 386/33. Classic Computing attributes development and manufacture to Triumph-Adler in Nuremberg.
product.ta-walkstation-386dx.technical.c: The ROM combined system and video code. MAME documents a 128 KiB image that includes the Cirrus Logic VGA BIOS.
product.ta-walkstation-386dx.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-walkstation-386dx.technical.l: The system ROM is preserved and hash-checked. MAME’s preliminary profile reports a blank screen and startup remains unverified.
product.ta-walkstation-386dx.technical.s: Centre for Computing History · Olivetti D33
